# CktHub

> CktHub sells standalone electronics hardware — ESP32 dev boards, power modules, enclosures, cables/connectors, and sensor modules — at a one-time price with no accounts or subscriptions. Ships from Pune, India. Checkout completes on WhatsApp.

CktHub is a brand of Ambivert Technologies Private Limited.

## Key facts
- One-time pricing, no accounts, no recurring subscriptions.
- Orders ship from Pune, India.
- Checkout finishes on WhatsApp; no payment is collected on-site.
- Custom hardware builds available: PCB design, SMT assembly, firmware, and enclosures.
- Contact: hello@ambiverttech.com / +91 99601 60016 / https://wa.me/919960160016

## Pages
- [Shop](https://ckthub.com/): full product catalog — dev boards, power, enclosures, cables & connectors, sensors & modules.
- [The idea / prototype](https://ckthub.com/prototype.html): why CktHub exists and what it replaces.
- [Fab](https://ckthub.com/fab.html): custom build / fabrication service.
